nodes.description: Private mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) _roles in AccessControl; stores role membership sets and admin role for every role.
bytes32 public constant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = 0x00; root admin role that itself is its own admin.
string _revertMsg in AccessControlMixin; revert message used by the only(role) modifier.
bool inited = false in Initializable; guards the initializer modifier, set to true on first initialize call.
bytes32 public constant MANAGER_ROLE = keccak256("MANAGER_ROLE"); access-control gate for exitTokens and lockTokens.
bytes32 public constant CUSTOM_EVENT_SIG; expected topic0 signature validated when parsing exit logs.
CustomPredicate.initialize(address _owner) external initializer; sets contract id and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANAGER_ROLE to _owner.
CustomPredicate.exitTokens(address withdrawer, address rootToken, bytes log) public override only(MANAGER_ROLE); parses RLP exit log and forwards decoded data to an external token contract.
CustomPredicate.lockTokens(...) external override only(MANAGER_ROLE); always reverts with 'Disabled feature'.
AccessControl.hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view; returns whether account is a member of role, reads _roles.
AccessControl.grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) public virtual; requires caller to hold role's admin role, then grants role.
AccessControl.revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) public virtual; requires caller to hold role's admin role, then revokes role.
AccessControl.renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) public virtual; requires account == _msgSender() so a caller may only renounce its own role.
AccessControl._setupRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal virtual; grants a role with no permission checks, intended only for constructors/initializers.
AccessControl._setRoleAdmin(bytes32 role, bytes32 adminRole) internal virtual; writes the adminRole of role into _roles.
AccessControl._grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) private; adds account to _roles[role].members and emits RoleGranted.
AccessControl._revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) private; removes account from _roles[role].members and emits RoleRevoked.
Context._msgSender() internal virtual view; returns msg.sender, the source of caller identity for all access-control checks.
AccessControlMixin.only(bytes32 role) modifier; requires hasRole(role, _msgSender()) with _revertMsg as the revert reason.
Initializable.initializer modifier; requires !inited then sets inited = true before running the function body.
External interface Data.setData(bytes calldata) invoked by CustomPredicate.exitTokens on the caller-supplied rootToken address.
Address.sendValue(address payable recipient, uint256 amount) internal; performs an arbitrary-value low-level call forwarding all gas.
Address._functionCallWithValue(target, data, weiValue, errorMessage) private; checks isContract(target) then performs target.call{value: weiValue}(data).
Address.isContract(address account) internal view; uses inline assembly extcodehash to detect whether an address is a contract.
RLPReader.toList(RLPItem) internal pure; expands an RLP list item into an array of RLPItem elements using inline assembly memory reads.
RLPReader.toRlpItem(bytes memory item) internal pure; wraps raw calldata bytes into an RLPItem with an assembly-computed memory pointer.
Caller-controlled address used as the identity for all role checks, role grants and role renouncements.
External call Data(rootToken).setData(data) in exitTokens with attacker-influenced target contract and attacker-decoded payload.
Low-level call recipient.call{value: amount}("") in Address.sendValue; forwards all gas and all requested value to an arbitrary address.
Low-level call target.call{value: weiValue}(data) in Address._functionCallWithValue; forwards all gas and value to target with arbitrary calldata.
Inline assembly using extcodehash / mload / mstore on raw memory pointers in Address.isContract, RLPReader and Address.copy.
_setupRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE/_MANAGER_ROLE, _owner) executed inside initialize without any access-control check; whoever calls initialize first becomes admin.
_owner parameter of CustomPredicate.initialize; receives DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANAGER_ROLE.
withdrawer parameter of exitTokens; compared against RLP topic1 (from address).
rootToken parameter of exitTokens; used as the target address of the external setData call.
log parameter of exitTokens; attacker-supplied RLP-encoded sidechain log that is decoded and trusted.
RLPItem[] logRLPList = log.toRlpItem().toList(); parsed list form of the exit log.
RLPItem[] logTopicRLPList = logRLPList[1].toList(); topics of the exit log, used for signature and sender checks.
bytes memory data = abi.decode(logRLPList[2].toBytes(), (bytes)); payload forwarded to the external rootToken contract.

edges.reason: _owner parameter is consumed by initialize when granting roles.
_owner is passed directly into the unchecked _setupRole calls inside initialize.
initialize executes the privileged _setupRole operations with no permission check.
initialize calls _setupRole to install the initial roles.
initialize uses DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE as the role granted to _owner.
initialize uses MANAGER_ROLE as the role granted to _owner.
initialize is guarded by the initializer modifier.
The initializer modifier writes inited = true, permanently blocking re-initialization.
The initializer modifier resumes execution of the initialize body after the guard passes.
withdrawer parameter is validated inside exitTokens.
rootToken parameter is supplied to exitTokens by the caller.
log parameter is the untrusted RLP blob processed by exitTokens.
log is converted into an RLPItem by toRlpItem.
toRlpItem result is immediately expanded by RLPReader.toList.
toList produces the logRLPList element array from the log.
The RLPItem returned by toRlpItem feeds the toList call that builds logRLPList.
logRLPList[1] is parsed by toList into logTopicRLPList.
logRLPList[2] from the caller-supplied log is abi.decode'd into data.
Attacker-controlled decoded data is forwarded as calldata in the external setData call.
Caller-supplied rootToken becomes the callee of the external setData call.
The external call hands control to Data(rootToken).setData on an attacker-chosen contract before exitTokens returns.
exitTokens reaches the unsafe external Data(rootToken).setData(data) call.
The only(MANAGER_ROLE) modifier gates execution of exitTokens.
The only(MANAGER_ROLE) modifier gates execution of lockTokens.
The only modifier consults hasRole to authorise the caller.
The only modifier uses _revertMsg as the revert reason when the role check fails.
The only modifier derives the checked identity from msg.sender via _msgSender.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender address.
_msgSender output is the account passed into hasRole by the only modifier.
MANAGER_ROLE is the required role in the only(MANAGER_ROLE) modifier on exitTokens and lockTokens.
CUSTOM_EVENT_SIG is compared against topic0 of the log inside exitTokens.
hasRole reads membership from the _roles state mapping.
grantRole consults hasRole(_roles[role].adminRole, _msgSender()) before granting.
revokeRole consults hasRole(_roles[role].adminRole, _msgSender()) before revoking.
grantRole delegates the write to _grantRole.
revokeRole delegates the write to _revokeRole.
renounceRole delegates the write to _revokeRole.
_setupRole grants a role by calling _grantRole without any authorisation.
_grantRole writes the member set of _roles[role].
_revokeRole mutates the member set of _roles[role].
_setRoleAdmin writes the adminRole field of _roles[role].
grantRole relies on msg.sender (via _msgSender) to decide whether the caller is the role admin.
revokeRole relies on msg.sender (via _msgSender) to decide whether the caller is the role admin.
renounceRole compares the untrusted msg.sender against the account being renounced.
grantRole resolves the caller identity through _msgSender.
revokeRole resolves the caller identity through _msgSender.
renounceRole resolves the caller identity through _msgSender.
msg.sender is the MANAGER_ROLE holder that triggers the external setData call in exitTokens.
Address.sendValue reaches the low-level value call.
The low-level call transfers control to the recipient contract while sendValue state is still in progress.
_functionCallWithValue reaches the low-level call with value and data.
The low-level call executes arbitrary code on the target contract before _functionCallWithValue resolves.
_functionCallWithValue requires isContract(target) before performing the call.
isContract performs inline assembly extcodehash on the raw address.

normalization_plan.reason: _owner is a local input of initialize and carries no independent semantics beyond the role-grant path.
withdrawer only exists to be validated against the RLP topic inside exitTokens.
rootToken is consumed directly as the callee address of the external Data(rootToken).setData call.
log is the untrusted RLP blob that exitTokens parses and ultimately forwards as calldata.
logRLPList is an intermediate parsed representation fully contained in exitTokens.
logTopicRLPList is an intermediate parsed topic array fully contained in exitTokens.
data is the decoded payload that becomes the calldata of the external setData call.
